building_prisms — DRIVE japan op

• Data kinds: any → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.building_prisms(buildings: 'Iterable[dict[str, Any]]', *, color_fn: 'Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Sequence[float]] | None' = None, base_z: 'float | None' = 0.0, roof_shade: 'float' = 0.92) -> 'tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]' (to call the implementation directly, import driveplateau; driveplateau.building_prisms(buildings: 'Iterable[dict[str, Any]]', *, color_fn: 'Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Sequence[float]] | None' = None, base_z: 'float | None' = 0.0, roof_shade: 'float' = 0.92) -> 'tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("building_prisms"))

Usage

Extrudes building footprints up to their heights and merges them into one triangle mesh.

Args:

buildings: the plateau_parse of buildings (footprint, height, ground_z).

color_fn: building -> (r,g,b) 0..1. If None, _default_building_color.

base_z: bottom z of all buildings [m]. If None, each building's ground_z is used (for worlds with relief).

0.0 suits a home-made flat road world.

roof_shade: colour multiplier for roof faces (a modest shade to tell them apart from the sides).

Returns:

(V (n,3) float64, F (m,3) int64, colors (m,3) float64 0..1, ids (m,) int64). ids[f] is the number of the building that face f belongs to (index into the input sequence). With 0 buildings each array is empty.

Raises:

ValueError: the return value of color_fn is not an RGB triple in 0..1, or a building's footprint/height is invalid.

Empty input (buildings with 0 entries) returns an empty result (reason: tiles with 0 buildings are common in real data. An empty set of prisms is the correct answer).
